name: product-builder
description: Turn product ideas into working products with landing pages, authentication, protected routes, and dashboard pages.

interface.longDescription: Helps turn an early product idea into a usable product. Product Builder first clarifies the audience, value proposition, core workflow, page map, and data model, then guides Codex through building the experience with a marketing landing page, login, registration, protected routes, dashboard pages, and polished shadcn/ui screens on the repo's Cloudflare Workers, React Router v7, Better Auth, and Tailwind CSS v4 stack.
defaultPrompt: Turn my product idea into a working product.
Build the landing page and protected product experience.
